bias.en: Uptrend · stalled at the $409–411 April high
bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 受阻于 4月高点 $409–411

read.en: Tesla slipped 0.8% on Oct 28 to $404.22, trading between $397.18 and $410.85. It is above the rising 5-day ($390.0), 10-day ($379.6) and 30-day ($373.9) averages and the falling 100-day ($367.9) and 200-day ($385.7). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 26 and above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 21 ($360.02), and RSI is 64.
read.zh: 特斯拉 10月28日小跌 0.8%，收于 $404.22，盘中区间 $397.18–410.85。股价位于上行的 5 日（$390.0）、10 日（$379.6）和 30 日均线（$373.9）以及下行的 100 日（$367.9）和 200 日均线（$385.7）上方。MACD 自 10月26日起位于信号线上方且在零轴之上，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月21日起看多（$360.02），RSI 为 64。

read.en: The high poked above the $409.3 Apr 17 high to $410.85 but the close fell back under it; the $395.3–397.3 support held at the $397.2 low. No level changed. Resistance is $409.3–410.9, then $416.4–420.3 (Mar 11 and Feb 25 highs) and $432.9 (Jul 1 high). Support is $395.3–397.3, then $385.7–390 ($388 cap, 200 and 5-day) and $373.9–379.6. A close above $411 would target $416–420; below $395, $388.
